pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: An orientation of at least 3 days shall be provided for all new teachers in the VIS program.

pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: Each School shall establish a Morning Block Team (MBT), which shall consist of the Supervisor (or her/his designee), the Building Representative (or her/his designee), the Instructional Coach, all department and grade level chairs, and other Teachers as designated by the Supervisor or the Building Representative.
